git clone https://github.com/nace-ai/drex-decision-models.git
cd drex-decision-models
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
hf download nace-ai/drex-dlm --local-dir weights/drex-dlm
python inference.py --model weights/drex-dlm --request examples/request.json

python serve.py --model weights/drex-dlm --port 8000
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/systemone \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d @examples/request.json

source .venv/bin/activate
python serve.py --model weights/drex-dlm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

git clone --branch edlm --single-branch https://github.com/nace-ai/llama.cpp.git llama.cpp
cmake -S llama.cpp -B llama.cpp/build
cmake --build llama.cpp/build --target llama-server --parallel 8

python3.12 -m venv llama.cpp/.venv-convert
llama.cpp/.venv-convert/bin/python -m pip install \
  -r llama.cpp/requirements/requirements-convert_hf_to_gguf.txt
llama.cpp/.venv-convert/bin/python llama.cpp/convert_hf_to_gguf.py weights/drex-dlm \
  --outfile weights/drex-dlm/drex-dlm-f16.gguf --outtype f16

GGML_METAL_TENSOR_DISABLE=1 llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server \
  -m weights/drex-dlm/drex-dlm-f16.gguf \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8097 \
  --embedding --pooling none \
  -c 16384 -b 16384 -ub 16384 -np 1 --no-warmup

curl http://127.0.0.1:8097/v1/systemone \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @examples/request.json

git clone --branch nace-edlm --single-branch https://github.com/nace-ai/ollama.git ollama
cd ollama
export OLLAMA_LLAMA_CPP_SOURCE="$PWD/../llama.cpp"
cmake -S llama/server --preset darwin
cmake --build build/llama-server-darwin --target llama-server --parallel 8
GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go build -trimpath -o ollama .
cd ..

cat > weights/drex-dlm/Modelfile <<'EOF'
FROM ./drex-dlm-f16.gguf
CAPABILITY decision
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
EOF

OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 \
OLLAMA_LLAMA_SERVER="$PWD/ollama/build/llama-server-darwin/bin/llama-server" \
  ollama/ollama serve

OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 ollama/ollama create drex-dlm \
  -f weights/drex-dlm/Modelfile
curl http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/systemone \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @examples/request.json
KEV_CONTEXT=32768 python serve.py --model weights/drex-dlm --port 8000

GGML_METAL_TENSOR_DISABLE=1 SYSTEMONE_CONTEXT=32768 llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server \
  -m weights/drex-dlm/drex-dlm-f16.gguf \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8097 \
  --embedding --pooling none \
  -c 32768 -b 32768 -ub 32768 -np 1 \
  --no-warmup
export DREX_API_KEY='paste-your-key-here'

items.quote: a stock llama.cpp or Ollama installation is not a supported runner

items.why_required: client: a decision model, not chat

items.why_required: the decision head reads per-token states (no pooling)

items.quote: The recommended serving context is 16,384 tokens; the model's maximum position window is 32,768 tokens.

items.why_required: -b must equal -c: the whole request is one batch
items.quote: Raise the encode cap (`SYSTEMONE_CONTEXT`) and the slot size (`-c`, `-b`, `-ub`) together:

items.why_required: -ub must equal -c: the bidirectional state is evaluated in one micro-batch
